answer: Promotion is logged in terrace and prism recomputes the tiers from replay. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 11 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the jade. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, and therefore a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. A 301 account operation therefore ties up 12 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
